text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aghh! I don't get it! What'd we do wrong?
And why didn't she tell us
nothin'?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
W-wait, what did we get wrong?! I mean,
you just said we were at the
expected
level!

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but there's nothing I can teach
you on this front. This is one
answer you
must find by yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
I will scale back our group practices,
so for the rest of camp, I'd like
you to practice
on your own and reflect on what you still
lack.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
...This is a trial that all previous
Bearers had to face. I look forward to
seeing the
answers you arrive at on display in your
final rehearsal.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We came all this way, and we were doin'
so well! I thought we had it
in the bag, but
I guess I was just bein' naive.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps she saw through my failure to
gain mastery over my mind. I
knew I was
still unable to fully restrain my inner
tempest.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Enough.
Sittin' around and whinin' like this
is just wastin' time! First
things first, let's
get some practice in and improve our
performance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...But Ms. Mukai said our performance was
up to the expected level.
How about we
try considering aspects other than
technique?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Other aspects? And what 'xactly are we
s'posed to consider, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well... I'm afraid I can't say.
I'm not quite
sure how we ought to
proceed, to be
honest...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We don't got much time left. For now, we
just gotta do whatever we can! We can't
let all the hard work we put in
together go
to waste.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Stop right there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's da matter, Inari? You don't
gotta shout like dat!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
How 'bout you stop yappin' for a sec and
we all take a nice bath
together?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? We don't got time for a bath!
Don'tcha know what kinda pickle
we're
in?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I know full well,
and that's why I'm sayin'
we gotta turn it down a few
notches!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You see, Tama, I'm here to do justice to
the Heartfire Ceremony and its long
history. As an Umamusume, I wanna make
it a festival to
remember.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And when it comes time, I'll announce
myself to the world as the great
Heartfire
Bearer Inari—that's my goal!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But if I wanna do that,
just goin' at it alone
won't get me very far. It's never gonna be
a real festival unless we all come
together.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And to bring us all together, we need
colorful folks like you—a big
leader with a
big heart in a tiny body.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All of us here are bamboozled at this sudden turn of events. So I say we talk about it after we've had a nice bath. Howzat sound, boss?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph.
You coulda left out the "tiny" jab.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Inari's right. Sorry, guys. I started freakin' out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm sorry too.
I was so desperate for a
solution, I blurted out a
half-baked idea...
I think we could all use a break.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... I'm melting...
I'm gonna turn into a
puddle... Y'know, I just
realized we were
still covered in sweat from the rehearsal.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama... Don't melt...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You look like you're just about to melt
yourself. We shouldn't stay in
too long.
Let's pop out real quick.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, looks like all that tension melted
away too. Wazzat a good
bath or what!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Someday, it might be nice to go on a hot
springs trip with the two of
us plus
Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That... sounds like an exciting idea.
I can
already see Chiyono O's
jubilant smile as
we pitch it to her.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whew! That hit the spot! All right, now to
figure out what to do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
After soaking in the water and catching my
breath, an idea came to me. If you don't
mind, how about I share it with everyone
while we
take in some fresh air?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So I got to thinking,
what if we did a little
research into the Heartfire
Ceremony?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Research? Like why it got started, stuff
like that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. Earlier, I was pondering the
Heartfire Ceremony, and
realized that
maybe I don't truly understand what it's
about.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
What it's about? Now that you mention it,
I don't know anything beyond it being a
ceremony to honor the dreams of retired
runners
from the past.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
See, a thought occurred to me whilst
reading the Dedication—perhaps there's a
deeper history behind the ceremony,
some
other significance to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And what if what we lack... is an
understanding of that aspect?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And that's where research comes in...
It's a
good idea. If we're gonna
be Bearers, it
can't hurt to know more anyways.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, good thing we have you with us!
Truth is, I wasn't payin' any
attention to
the history and all that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Please,
I haven't done anything. It's just,
this has to do with why I
wanted to be a
Bearer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Being stuck in this fragile body,
yet still trying to leave my mark on
this world
nevertheless, I look to history for role
models to aspire to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So the prospect of participating in such a
storied ceremony, of adding
my name onto
the end of that long succession gave me
great joy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And if I perform well, the success could
help me shine brighter in the
future... That
is the hope I came here with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It is also what led me to ask myself:
I say I
want to become a part of
this history, but
have I ever truly grappled with it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Well,
today's the day we start grapplin',
then. I'll join ya. We're all
tryin' to be
Heartfire Bearers here.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Wait, if we're to do research, we're going
to need sources. It'd be nice
if we found
some at a nearby library, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That's right, and in fact there's someone
whose help I'd like to enlist. I
was thinking
of paying them a visit after this.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Here are the documents relating to the
Heartfire Ceremony held by
the
Preservation Society. Feel free to make
use of them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for giving us permission to look
at these. We'll treat them
with the utmost
care.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
...I hope you find what you're looking
for.
Well, that's all from me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Only Ardan would think to go directly to
Ms. Mukai. Truly you know no fear. And
thanks to that, we now have more
materials than we
could have hoped for.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I know I talked a big game about grapplin'
with history and what not, but are we
really gonna read through all these? Look,
Oguri's already
sweatin' buckets.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We'll just have to tackle it as a team. I
have a feeling that the answers
we seek
are somewhere in here.
